name: Dead Tide IX: Porn and Prejudice
source:
Led ashore by the beautiful vampire and Dread Pirate Queen Jessenia, the crew stumble upon a renegade Drow porn operation that has taken the port by storm. Disturbed by what is clearly a plot to dethrone her as “the most fuckable slut in the Seven Realms”, Jessenia sets out to make her own pornography, porn so enticing and salacious as to sweep all the debauched Drow smut back into the Underdark!
